title: Carrot Top Hospitalized After Reported Suicide Attempt, Cancels Weekend Shows
summary: The 61-year-old comedian is recovering, according to his representatives.
contentText:
Carrot Top has reportedly been hospitalized following a suicide attempt.

The 61-year-old comedian and longtime Las Vegas performer, whose real name is Scott Thompson, attempted suicide Friday (Sept. 18) and was taken to a local hospital, according to TMZ .

His representatives confirmed Saturday that Thompson is hospitalized and recovering, according to NBC News .

Schlicher did not disclose the circumstances leading up to Thompson’s hospitalization.

Carrot Top, who is known for his high-energy prop comedy and signature bright-red hair, canceled his residency shows at the Atrium Showroom at Luxor Hotel & Casino on Friday and Saturday. Tickets for his upcoming shows were still available for purchase at press time.

The comedian’s residency at the Las Vegas venue began more than two decades ago, in November 2005. His contract with the Luxor extends through 2030, according to MGM Resorts .

The Vegas mainstay first appeared on Star Search in 1991 and later established himself as a prop comedian. He has made numerous cameos in television shows and films, including Hacks , Scrubs , Pauly Shore Is Dead , Glee , Family Guy , Robot Chicken , CSI: Crime Scene Investigation and Reno 911!

He was also a frequent guest on the Jerry Lewis MDA Labor Day Telethon and teamed with PACER’s National Bullying Prevention Center to form the Together Against Bullying (TAG) campaign.

For those who are experiencing suicidal thoughts and/or distress, the  988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline  is available 24/7 by calling or texting 988, which will connect you to trained counselors for confidential support.
